Name: SDV Twitch
Author: dawgeth
Description:
How to Configure:

You need a Twitch Client ID.. These are free, and easy to get!

1. Go here: [url=https://dev.twitch.tv/]https://dev.twitch.tv[/url]
2. Log in with your Twitch account.
3. Click on your name, top right corner.
4. Click Dashboard.
5. Click the Apps tab.
6. Click Register Your Application.
7. Give it a name, set an oauth redirect url (can be anything - you wont be using OAuth), and choose Game Integration from the drop down menu.
8. Click Register.
9. Make note of your client ID on the next screen.
10. Unzip the downloaded file to your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
11. Inside the MTD.SDVTwitch folder, edit config.json.
12. Set your Twitch Name.
13. Set your client ID.
14. Save and Close the File.
15. Launch the Game, Stream, and Enjoy!
